name: SpatialAssociation
description: Compare two spatial cell abundance profiles, then compare groups using one score per patient.

operation.description: Analyze spatial association of two cell abundances.

input_path.description: Local h5ad or CSV with coordinates, abundances, and spot metadata.

output_dir.description: Parent directory for CSV, JSON, and PNG results.

patient_key.description: Metadata column with patient IDs. Each patient contributes one score.

group_key.description: Metadata column with one group per patient.

domain_key.description: Metadata column with spatial domain labels.

slice_key.description: Metadata column for sections. Defaults to slice_id or library_id when present, otherwise one slice per patient.

abundance_key.description: Name of an obsm DataFrame for h5ad input. Omit to read abundances from obs.

coordinate_key.description: Name of the coordinate matrix in h5ad obsm. Defaults to spatial.

x_key.description: CSV x column. Defaults to x.

y_key.description: CSV y column. Defaults to y.

method.description: Compare abundances at the same spot or across neighboring spots.

n_neighbors.description: Nearest neighbors per spot before symmetrization. Neighborhood only.

max_neighbor_distance.description: Optional distance cap in input coordinate units. Neighborhood only.

domains.description: Optional domain labels to retain before calculating association.

compare_groups.description: Optional two groups in subtraction order. Defaults to sorted labels when there are at most two.

n_permutations.description: Number of spatial permutations and maximum number of patient-group permutations.
